svg.title: One request, three processes, one block pool
svg.desc: A chat request crosses the API server, the engine core, and a GPU worker, drawn as machines on one bench. On our L4 with Qwen3-8B, 87.2 percent of the prompt tokens came from the prefix cache. Below, towers show the median time to first token with the cache on and off at 256, 1,024, and 2,048 shared tokens.

g.text: PROMPT TOKENS AS THE PREFIX CACHE SAW THEM, 8 USERS
87.2 percent from the cache, in 16-token blocks
